attribution.modifications: Converted original Blender mesh and existing 21-bone weighted metarig to standard Y-up GLB; selected the original archive's default Skeleton/base.png texture instead of the GameBoyColor variant active in the saved Blender file. Normalized source skin-weight totals while retaining every influence and its relative ratio (including five influences on nine source vertices). Applied non-uniform armature and mesh object scales to the real geometry and rest rig, checking that evaluated bind shape was unchanged. Preserved rig proportions and authored materials; no replacement rig or animation was generated. Embedded source attribution and generated a rendered model preview.
